meta.purpose: Controlled complete-release time breakdown and persistent-storage table preview; not measurements.
meta.configuration_scope: Yambda/RecFlow × Large/Max. Population and phase times are declared layout assumptions, not frozen evaluation settings.
meta.source_scope: New whole-trace synthetic ledger. It does not reinterpret the legacy independent per-path examples as a measured cycle.
meta.numeric_policy: No FLOPs, bytes or peak GPU rate is converted to time. No invented timing repetitions or confidence intervals.
meta.time_scope: One controlled first-release trace on matched hardware and batching. Whole phases include setup, all events, re-anchoring and movement. The service block is split into native-reference time plus an algebraic corrected-minus-native delta, not separately timed subparts of a fused kernel.
meta.storage_scope: Persistent cache and correction state only, not GPU allocation or cumulative transfer bytes. Native K/V covers all declared stored users and full windows. Added storage includes one anchor/current code buffer, full-catalogue fixed/current item tables, the old item table retained at handover, and the declared shared parameter bundle. Shared objects count once per declared replica. Common datasets and foundation checkpoints are excluded from both columns; temporary execution workspaces are outside persistent storage. All sizes and catalogue counts are synthetic, with RecFlow shapes still hypothetical.
meta.inputs: Operation times and counts below are synthetic placeholders. Real execution must measure complete trace duration and reconcile exclusive phase attribution.

scenario.common_foundation_training: Common checkpoint training is outside this release-processing comparison.
scenario.time_attribution: Measure disjoint whole phases and reconcile to complete trace time. Plot corrected service as native-reference service plus its measured difference. Transfers are charged once. Packing and synchronization belong to their executing phase. Never sum overlapped phases or interpret the service difference as an independently timed kernel.
